newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr yields end edge down on rate cut hope.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr yields end edge down on rate cut hope.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporate bonds closed slightly lower on Wednesday as expectations of a cut in interest rates buoyed buying sentment, brokers said.
Money demand was seen increasing in the short-term money market, but the overnight call rates remained unchanged.
The three-month CD yields rose due to tightening money demand.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.22 pct from 12.23 on Tuesday
* Overnight call average unchanged at 11.90 pct
The central bank said it supplied 600 billion won to local commercial banks through repurchase agreements.
The bank said the fund supply were aimed at stabilising the money market for the time being.
Money demand was seen increasing in the short-term money market, but the overnight call rates remained unchanged.
Three-month CD yields rose due to the increasing money demand.
